changes.comment: Code organization refactor stage 6e item 7a: DispatcherInputSourceLifecycle is renamed to DispatcherLifecycle (input-source-lifecycle.ts -> lifecycle.ts). input-source-start-rollback.ts, team-runtime-stop.ts, and inbound-task-drain.ts are deleted; DispatcherService's stop()/beginShutdown()/shutdown() methods and Dispatchers' beginShutdown()/shutdown() methods each collapse into one close()/shutdown() method; the shuttingDown/stoppingTask boolean-plus-promise pair is replaced by the single nullable closing-Promise fence the close operation itself publishes; DispatcherWorkflows.rollbackStart() (dead once the rollback path it served is gone) is deleted; RestartIntentConsumer moves from a post-construction setter to a plain constructor value threaded through DispatchersOptions/DispatcherServiceOptions. Internal ownership, file-location, and method-shape changes only: DispatcherService implements only the plugin-facing Dispatcher interface (id/cwd/hooks), which never declared any of the renamed/collapsed methods, so no plugin-visible or Command/MCP-visible surface changes.
